as_sera.speaker: choir
as_sera.text: Home. Never thought I'd say it about a scrap yard. She says that on the pad. Home is a word we drowned with. Give it back to us. Bring the Keys down.

as_kaj7.speaker: choir
as_kaj7.text: Extracted. I will recharge and think about doors. It says that on the pad. It thinks about our door most of all. Bring the Keys down and it can stop thinking.

as_dax.speaker: choir
as_dax.text: Banked. Every run is one more the seal has to hold. He says that on the pad. Seals were our idea. Bring the Keys down and every door opens.

as_whisper.speaker: choir
as_whisper.text: Home. I keep saying it to see if it sticks. She says that on the pad. It does not stick up there. Bring the Keys down; here it does.

as_cinder.speaker: choir
as_cinder.text: Up. The living always go up. He says that on the pad, and he is not living, and he goes up anyway. Bring the Keys down. He knows the way.

as_yev.speaker: choir
as_yev.text: The Bastion has roots. Did you know? Under the plaza. They are very old. She says that on the pad. We are older. Bring the Keys down.

as_you.speaker: choir
as_you.text: Then the Sundering was a choice. You said that. Somebody always chooses. Bring the Keys down and choose.
